evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes.
